sanskrit:
यतेन्द्रियमनोबुद्धि र्मुनिर्मोक्षपरायणः ।
विगतेच्छाभयक्रोधो यः सदा मुक्त एव सः ॥ ५-२८॥
iast:
yatendriya manobuddhir munirmokṣaparāyaṇaḥ
vigatecchābhayakrodho yaḥ sadā mukta eva saḥ 5-28
translation: With senses, mind and intellect (ever) controlled, having liberation as his Supreme Goal, free from desire, fear and anger — the sage is verily liberated for ever.
